title: Nous Hermes Agent: Autonomous Self-Evolving Framework
summary: An open-source autonomous agent framework designed for persistent, self-improving workflows using a closed learning loop. It leverages Xiaomi's MiMo reasoning models and features integrated cloud browsing for robust web interaction.
research_notes: Uses Markdown skill files (SKILL.md) for persistent learning; features a 'Tenacity' Kanban board for long-running goal tracking.

evolution.summary: Introduced 'The Curator' for autonomous skill auditing, a unified cloud/local browser gateway, and native support for Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Pro reasoning models.
